```{r, include = FALSE }
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r Library_import}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)
library(DOSE)
library(forcats)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(msigdbdf)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(GOSemSim)
library(stringr)
```


```{r, include = FALSE }
wd <- params$wd
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = wd)
out_dir <- params$outdir
DEGs_path <- params$DEGs_path
```

```{r import DEGs list and order it}
setwd(wd)

# Load differential expressed genes 
DEGs <- read.csv(DEGs_path, h = T)

# Rename column for simplicity downstream
colnames(DEGs)[colnames(DEGs) == "log2FoldChange"] <- "log2FC"

# Keep only the columns needed for building the GSEA ranked gene list
DEGs <- DEGs %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene_name, pval, log10_pval, log2FC)


# Build the ranking metric for GSEA: combine direction of change (sign of log2FC) with statistical significance (log10 p-value)
geneList <- with(DEGs, setNames(sign(log2FC) * log10_pval, gene_name))

# Sort genes from most positive to most negative score so that least interesting genes are in the middle of the list 
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

```


```{r GSEA}
setwd(paste0(wd,out_dir))
# This block performs GSEA against GO:BP than Hallmark and combines the two results 

# Performs GSEA against Gene Ontology Biological Process terms, using the ranked gene list built earlier (signed significance score)
gobp_res <- gseGO(
  geneList      = geneList,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.01,
  verbose       = FALSE
)


# GO terms are highly redundant (many similar/overlapping terms), so this collapses similar terms together keeping the most significant one
gobp_simplified <- clusterProfiler::simplify(
  gobp_res,
  cutoff     = 0.7, # if you want to keep more terms, increase the cutoff. If you want less lower it 
  by         = "p.adjust",
  select_fun = min
)

# Extract results table and indicate the source database
gobp_df <- gobp_simplified@result %>%
  mutate(database = "GO:BP")


# Get MSigDB Hallmark gene sets 
hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) # if you want to perform GSEA against other gene sets check msigdbr_collections()

# Perform GSEA against Hallmark gene sets, tryCatch so a failure (e.g. no significant terms) doesn't stop the whole script
hallmark_res <- tryCatch(
  GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE = hallmark_sets, pvalueCutoff = 0.01, verbose = FALSE),
  error = function(e) { message("Hallmark GSEA failed: ", e$message); NULL }
)

# Extract results table and tag the source database
hallmark_df <- hallmark_res@result %>%
  mutate(database = "Hallmark")

# Merge both result sets into one table with only the columns needed for plotting
combined_df <- bind_rows(
  gobp_df     %>% dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust, NES, database),
  hallmark_df %>% dplyr::select(Description, p.adjust, NES, database)
) %>%
  mutate(color = ifelse(NES < 0, "Enriched in Non-SARC", "Enriched in SARC"))

# For each database and enrichment direction, keep only the top N terms ranked by absolute NES
TOP_N <- 5 # Change the value here if you want to plot less/more terms 
plot_df <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(database, color) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>%
  slice_head(n = TOP_N) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert Hallmark to title case, leave GO:BP as it is
    Description = ifelse(
      database == "Hallmark",
      str_to_title(str_replace_all(Description, "_", " ")),  
      Description
    ),
    label = Description
  )

gg <- ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = NES,
           y = reorder(label, NES),
           fill = color)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(
    x     = "Normalised Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y     = NULL,
    fill  = NULL,
    title = "GSEA – Hallmark & GO:BP"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Enriched in Non-SARC" = "royalblue",
    "Enriched in SARC"     = "palegreen"
  )) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin     = margin(10, 20, 10, 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10), 
    axis.title.x = element_text( size = 12)
  )

plot(gg)

if (!dir.exists("1_Differential_expression")) {
  dir.create("1_Differential_expression")
}

ggsave("1_Differential_expression/GSEA_result.pdf")

# Extract leading-edge genes (genes driving the enrichment signal) 
leading_edge <- hallmark_res@result %>%
  dplyr::select(Description, NES, pvalue, p.adjust, core_enrichment) %>%
  mutate(
    genes = str_replace_all(core_enrichment, "/", ", ")
  )

print(leading_edge)
```
